source.note: Same kit and recipe as mini-female-a (FBX member with its colour map, all 32 clips with their Kenney names, height 1.1 m: Kenney minis are chibi, the head is about 40 % of the body, so a real adult scale would make the head huge; noon script, faceted shading). Her outfit is set apart from mini-female-a and mini-male-a within the noon script: white top, red trousers, auburn-brown hair, dark shoes. Kenney uses one yellow swatch for both her top and her hair clip, so the clip is white like the top. The FBX rest pose is a T-pose, so views use idle@0. Ground: moving clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are lifted onto the ground plane (set their lift to 0 to seat her on a chair or wheelchair at the authored height). Her arm stubs stay above the soles, so no clip needs sinkAllowed.
